spectators.label: Backpacker with walking stick
spectators.look: scruffy young backpacker with messy brown hair under a red bandana and light stubble; olive hiking shirt, khaki shorts, tall hiking boots, a huge overloaded green backpack with a rolled sleeping mat on top, a wooden walking stick
spectators.idle: thumbs hooked in his backpack straps, gazing at the ring
spectators.shocked: staggering backward under the weight of the backpack

spectators.label: Photographer with telephoto lens
spectators.look: focused woman photographer with short teal hair under a beige cap turned backward; tan photographer's vest full of pockets over a gray tee, black pants, a black camera with a long white telephoto lens
spectators.idle: camera raised to her eye, framing the ring
spectators.cheer: snapping photos one-handed, other fist raised
spectators.shocked: camera flash going off as she leans back

spectators.label: Tourist dad with map
spectators.look: sunburned chubby tourist dad with sunglasses pushed onto his forehead and a khaki bucket hat; loud yellow Hawaiian shirt with red hibiscus flowers, cargo shorts, white socks with brown sandals, a huge unfolded paper map
spectators.idle: squinting at the giant unfolded map
spectators.cheer: waving the map overhead like a flag
spectators.shocked: map ripping in half, jaw dropped

spectators.label: Little tourist with ice cream
spectators.look: small girl in a wide straw sun hat with a red ribbon; pale yellow sundress, white sandals, a dripping strawberry ice-cream cone in one hand and a tiny golden souvenir trophy in the other
spectators.idle: licking the ice cream, staring at the ring
spectators.cheer: holding the little trophy up high
spectators.shocked: ice-cream scoop falling onto her sandals

spectators.label: Lanky tourist with guidebook
spectators.look: tall lanky blond foreign tourist with freckles and round wire glasses; white polo shirt, beige shorts, knee-high socks, a bright orange fanny pack, a thick guidebook with a plain blue cover
spectators.idle: reading the guidebook and pointing at the ring
spectators.cheer: guidebook held up, arm out to the side, cheering

spectators.label: Tour guide with pennant
spectators.look: cheerful tour guide with a neat dark bun under a small teal pillbox hat; teal blazer with a white scarf, knee-length teal skirt, a silver whistle on a cord, a small triangular yellow pennant with a star on a short stick
spectators.idle: holding the pennant up for her tour group
spectators.cheer: waving the pennant and blowing the whistle
spectators.shocked: whistle falling from her lips, pennant drooping

spectators.label: Tourist granny with camera
spectators.look: tiny hunched granny with a white curly perm under a purple sun visor; oversized pink windbreaker, beige slacks, white sneakers, a black fanny pack and a little disposable camera on a wrist strap
spectators.idle: shading her eyes with one hand, peering at the ring
spectators.cheer: hopping and waving the little camera
spectators.shocked: hand on her heart, eyes wide

spectators.label: Desert wanderer
spectators.look: tan-skinned desert traveler woman with a sand-colored head wrap and face scarf, brass goggles on her forehead; long dusty khaki duster coat, brown wrapped boots, a dented metal canteen on a strap
spectators.cheer: pulling down the scarf and raising a fist
spectators.shocked: scarf whipping back, goggles slipping down

spectators.label: Selfie influencer
spectators.look: trendy young woman with pastel pink and baby-blue split-dyed hair in a high ponytail and heart-shaped sunglasses; lavender bomber jacket, white pleated skirt, chunky white sneakers, a phone on a selfie stick
spectators.idle: posing for a selfie with the stick, pouting
spectators.cheer: selfie stick held high, peace sign
spectators.shocked: phone slipping off the selfie stick, mouth open

spectators.label: Tired salaryman traveler
spectators.look: tired traveling salaryman with messy black hair and bags under his eyes, a gray neck pillow around his neck; wrinkled gray suit, loosened blue tie, a small black rolling suitcase at his side
spectators.idle: yawning, one hand on the suitcase handle
spectators.cheer: tie tied around his head like a headband, shouting
spectators.shocked: neck pillow flying off, eyes popping

spectators.label: Safari explorer
spectators.look: barrel-chested explorer with a white pith helmet and a bushy ginger handlebar mustache; khaki safari jacket with many pockets, khaki shorts, tall brown socks and boots, black binoculars around his neck
spectators.cheer: pith helmet waved out to the side, cheering

spectators.label: Island girl with coconut drink
spectators.look: dark-skinned teenage island girl with long braided black hair and a pink flower behind her ear; colorful flower lei around her neck, orange sundress with white flowers, a coconut drink with a striped straw
spectators.cheer: dancing with the coconut held high
spectators.shocked: coconut drink spilling down her front

spectators.label: Northern traveler in furs
spectators.look: big rosy-cheeked traveler from the cold north with a brown fur hat with ear flaps and a bushy blond beard; thick red parka, long red scarf, gray mittens, felt boots, a steaming metal cup of tea
spectators.cheer: mittens raised out to the sides, bellowing
spectators.shocked: hat ear flaps flying straight up

spectators.label: Autograph hunter boy
spectators.look: eager freckled boy with a backward blue cap and a gap-toothed grin; yellow-and-white striped tee, red cargo shorts, a small sticker-covered backpack, an autograph notebook and a black marker
spectators.cheer: notebook and marker thrust toward the ring

spectators.label: Traveling painter
spectators.look: older traveling painter with a white goatee, a dark red beret and a paintbrush tucked behind his ear; paint-splattered blue smock over brown trousers, a small sketchpad and a wooden palette
spectators.idle: sketching the fight on the sketchpad
spectators.shocked: a splash of paint across his face
